p.d: S1 E2 — Denise ScottComedian Denise Scott plays for a charity close to her heart. Joined by husband John and comic superstars Dave Hughes, Claire Hooper, Geraldine Hickey, Dave O'Neil, and Bron Lewis, can Denise beat the banker?

S6 E21 — Episode 21Taking a fun look at the week that was are The Cheap Seats hosts Melanie Bracewell and Tim McDonald. Joining in on the action are Mel Tracina, comedian Lena Moon and podcaster Luke Rocca.
S1 E2 — Episode 2Good vibes, great guests, glorious fringe. Your weekly dose of Claudia-powered joy, as she has a chat with Hollywood stars, the best of British and her gorgeous studio audience.
S1 E5 — Splitting ImagesAfter a series of humiliating run-ins with Dash (the school bully), Danny uses his powers to get revenge.

S1 E6 — What You WantWhen Desiree - a ghost that can grant wishes - gives Tucker ghost powers, Danny finds himself dealing with his friend's jealousy in the worst way possible: by having to fight him.

S1 E18 — The Aloha Kid / Otto MobileTito's nephew visits for a surfing invitational. He starts to give Otto competition and gets all the attention of his friends. // Tito gets sick and can't work, so Raymundo makes Reggie and Otto work.

S1 E19 — Big Air Dare / Otto's Big BreakOtto and Reggie are in a fierce battle to see who is the best snowboarder. They decide to go on The Big Air. // Otto breaks his leg but still tries to play all of the sports he always did.

S5 E14 — Grandpa's Packard / Phoebe's Little ProblemGrandpa enters his Packard in the classic car competition. It is admired by all until it is stolen. / Phoebe wins a perfect attendance award, but on stage, a microphone amplifies her accidental gas.

S5 E15 — A Day In The Life Of A Classroom / Big Bob's CrisisMr. Simmons wins the Teacher Of The Year Award and a TV channel wants to do a documentary on him. / Big Bob has a change of heart when he has what appears to be a heart attack.

S1 E7 — Chilly Dog / The DoomiesDudley and Kitty's have to go undercover as ice skaters after the world's greatest figure skaters are kidnapped. // Disguised as super villains, Dudley and Kitty attend to an awardshow in which villains show off their evil moves.

S1 E108 — Never Say XeverLeo fears his act of mercy has come back to haunt him when Xever, Chris Bradford, the Purple Dragons and the Foot Ninjas hold the blind local noodle shop owner Mr. Murakami hostage.
S1 E109 — The GauntletAfter April receives a warning from her imprisoned father, she and the Turtles embark on a mission to save him and stop the Kraang from detonating a mutagen bomb.

S13 E23 — Spatula Of The Heavens / Gary's PlayhouseSpongeBob embarks on an epic journey to have his beloved spatula reforged by the legendary Guru Greasetrap. // SpongeBob builds a snail-house outside for Gary to play in while he is at work.

S13 E24 — Swimming Fools / The GoobfatherSpongeBob builds a pool in his backyard and Squidward tries to resist taking a dip. // Mr. Krabs must reckon with the Goobfather after he adds Patty Whips to the menu at the Krusty Krab.

The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It's all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked it and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of his injuries.

Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us it's like a third testicle swinging in the wind. But when it comes to surgery it's no laughing matter for Chris.

Boris the Staffy was born with a cleft palate and seven operations have failed. Jess won't give up, so Chris attempts Australia's first surgery of its kind—raising eight grand to give Boris one last chance.

West Highland terrier, Chester lives in Bondi but has a fanatical hatred of skateboarders. It’s a dangerous combination and one that is making life hell for his owners Mark and Jess. They’re worried Chester could bite someone.

6 month old German Shepherd, Gypsy hasn't been able to keep any food down for weeks and is losing weight rapidly. But getting to the bottom of the problem is proving impossible as the petrified patient refuses to let anybody examine her.
A tense night as Chris fights to save a policeman's poisoned pet, rescues a malnourished penguin that washed up onshore and operates on a young pup with a disintegrating leg.

Chris confronts a bizarre and shocking act of cruelty as a 12-year-old cat is deliberately dumped in the Bondi surf and left to die. There's also a depressed parrot caught in a bizarre love triangle, and can Lisa help a beautiful Samoyed survive a killer tick bite?

A groundbreaking operation is happening at the Bondi clinic: Elroy, the out-of-control bulldog is being desexed, and Chris is about to give him the very latest fake silicone testicles direct from the United States. Lisa hopes a blood transfusion can save a senior citizen. There are some very different patients including a sick owl spreading some nasty bugs and a turtle that's wandered way off track.

On this episode you will lose your heart to a brave golden retriever and her devoted owner. Rosie has severely deformed legs and only major surgery can save her life. How will owner Angus find the money and will the operation work? Chris also introduces us to one of Bondi's most delightful dog-loving eccentrics, and a cutting-edge solution for a record-breaking goat.

Montgomery Brewster is a low-league baseball player who suddenly finds out that a distant relative has left him $300 million. However, there's a catch: he has to waste $30 million in just 30 days without anyone knowing he's doing it.

Up-and-coming entertainment lawyer Walter Fielding takes the big step with his girlfriend and purchases a fixer-upper for a "steal". As it turns out, the "steal" is really a "rip-off" and everything that can go wrong, does.
A bumbling relative gets the chance to redeem himself when he's called upon to look after his brother's three children.

An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.
An arrogant TV weatherman finds himself repeating the same day over and over again when he goes on location to the small town of Punxsutawney to film a report about their annual Groundhog Day.
Dinosaur expert Dr Alan Grant and a search party become trapped on an island of prehistoric predators. Can they escape alive with Dr Alan Grant leading the party?
A lone outcast is charged with a mission to vanquish Dracula, the Wolfman and Frankenstein's monster in the dark, shadowy world of Transylvania.
A fun trip turns into a living nightmare when passengers from a destroyed seaplane become stranded with great white sharks circling their raft.
Spencer returns to the fantastical world of Jumanji. His friends Martha, Fridge, and Bethany follow his footsteps in an effort to try and bring him home.
Two handymen and a seismology student battle giant carnivorous sandworms, the reason behind the mysterious deaths occurring in the small town of Perfection, Nevada.
A giant shark is feeding on the good people of Amity Island, and it's up to police chief Martin Brody to hunt down the finned fiend.

After crashing on an unknown planet, two survivors quickly discover they're actually stranded on Earth, 65 million years ago. With only one chance at a rescue, they must make their way across an unknown terrain riddled with prehistoric creatures.
Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into over-protective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teen-aged daughter.

In this all-new monster comedy adventure, everything seems to be changing for the better at Hotel Transylvania! However, Drac is worried that his adorable half-human, half-vampire grandson, Dennis, isn't showing signs of being a vampire. So while Mavis is on vacation, things get batty as Drac enlists his monster friends Frank, Murray, Wayne and Griffin to put Dennis through a "monster-in-training" boot camp!
During a family trip on a luxury monster cruise, Dracula finds himself falling for the mysterious captain of the ship.

On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.

During an expedition Dr Rick Marshall, his research assistant, and a redneck survivalist are sucked into a space-time vortex. They find themselves in an alternate universe and become friends with a primate named Chaka.

Jurassic World, a fully functional dinosaur park that sees 20,000 visitors a year, is the realisation of owner John Hammond's dreams. However, scientists may have gone too far in creating a hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park.

Owen and Claire return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinosaurs while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine whether human beings are to remain the apex predators.
After being suspended, Jesse Stone starts to work for an old friend; he investigates a series of murders in Boston and discovers a link to an infamous gangster.
Hidden secrets and long-buried resentments come to light when two estranged brothers reunite at a primitive cabin deep in the woods of Northern England.

A shark-obsessed serial killer holds Zephyr, a rebellious surfer, captive on his boat. Racing against time, she must figure out a way to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.

Quarterback Cameron Cade trains at an isolated compound with his hero, Isaiah White. As training progresses, Isaiah's charisma turns into something darker, sending Cam down a disorienting rabbit hole that may cost him more than he ever bargained for.
A border town sheriff faces the wrath of a brutal cartel when a mysterious prisoner lands in his jail.

p.t: Kerouac's Road: The Beat of a Nation
p.d: Explores how the legacy of Jack Kerouac's iconic novel, On the Road, reflects in modern-day America, interweaving stories of on-the-roaders who share connections to Kerouac's life.

When Mike's 11-year-old sister sneaks out to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy, she sets into motion a terrifying series of events that reveal dark secrets about the true origin of Freddy's.
A socially awkward tween endures the ruthless hierarchy at a water polo camp, his anxiety spiralling into psychological turmoil over the summer.
An LAPD officer discovers a police task force is harbouring a horrific secret that endangers residents of the housing projects he grew up in.

A masked maniac with glowing, red eyes returns every Valentine's Day to slaughter unsuspecting couples. When a cynical ad executive and her hopelessly romantic colleague become the next target, they decide to fight back and end the reign of terror.
Maya squares off against the masked killers one last time in a brutal, full-circle reckoning of survival and revenge.

On the eve of the 2002 FIFA World Cup, the Irish captain Roy Keane forfeits his place in the squad at the team's preparation base in Saipan, following a heated disagreement with the Irish manager Mick McCarthy.

Four years after her last encounter with Michael Myers, Laurie Strode finally decides to liberate herself and embrace life. However, a local murder unleashes a cascade of violence and terror that forces her to confront the evil she can't control.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Valentine's Day
p.d: S1 E3Dingo wakes up to a sore hand following the Loon Mountain after-party and describes what life will be like on the road with Lucas. After packing up the RV, the boys grab some food and hit some local wood rails, before leaving for Dannys hometown stop, Mountain creek, NJ. As the tour heads to New Jersey, Dingo takes the Boost bus to spend some time with Loon Mountain winner, Travis Neuenhaus. Instead of getting to know Travis, Dingo is interrogated by his Travis father about what Grenade life entails. With the 3rd stop, Mountain Creek, only a few days away, the gang makes it to Dannys parents house (located a few miles from the mountain) just in time for Valentines Day. Dingo quickly lines up a date with Kylie, whom he had met at the NYC rail jam in the previous episode. Meanwhile, Danny prepares for his ex-girlfriend, Thania, to arrive.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Mountain Creek
p.d: S1 E4Danny's ex-girlfriend, Thania, joins the tour for the 3rd stop, Mountain Creek. The crew heads to the mountain and squeezes some snowboarding of their own in, before judging the first night's rail contest. Day 2 of Mountain Creek proves to be the best competition yet, and Danny's father signs on to be a judge along with another home town hero, Sketchy D. The 3rd trip to Grenade games is won by Timmy Kempson, who takes the crew to his house and shows off his backyard training facilities. Upon returning to Mountain Creek the next day to pick up the RV, they discover that a snowboard instructor has broken into the bus and stolen their gloves. After saying good by to Danny's parents and ex-girlfriend, the gang heads to the final Zumiez signing, in Long Island, where bus driver, Dawain, gets everyone lost for hours.

p.t: The Adventures of Danny and the Dingo: Layover In Cleveland
p.d: S1 E5The boys finish their last Zumiez signing in Long Island. On the way to Raging Buffalo they decide to stop halfway in Cleveland.  Dawain, the bus driver, gets lost and begins driving in circles around Manhattan. Carolla, the camera man, takes charge of the Grenade RV and suggests that they drive straigistake of giving the producer a wedgie in which he retaliates with permanent reht to his mothe's house in Cleveland. The gang is in for a surprise when a very energetic mother greats everyone with Apple-cran martinis at 9am. After spending the morning at Carolla's mother's house, Danny, Dingo and Lucas decide to get tattoos. Lucas makes the msults for Lucas. With one stop left to go, the gang heads to the final stop Raging Buffalo and gets day 1 underway. That night the boys decide to go for a nice meal. At the table Goon takes a joke a little too far triggering Dingo into hitting Lucas so hard a lump the size of a golf ball forms on his forehead.

p.t: Drive Thru - South Africa - The Airline Strike
p.d: S3 E7The airlines go on strike, and the crew is left with its biggest decision. To settle on a solution is becoming more and more complicated as the trip moves on with no one person making a call. The crew elects Pottz to take charge, and the decision is made to drive down to J-Bay. This means one more night at Rudy's and another chance to surf out at the bluff.

It's believed the activity stems from the suicide of Ladell Allen, who's love affair with a married man broker her heart. TAPS members see black figures, smell sulfur, and record an EVP voice.

At the courthouse, Adam and Amy experience hair pulling and a cell door shaking, but inside the restaurant, the team does much debunking.

The program aims to provide spiritual principles and practices that can help people, as they become happy students of Jesus and live a life of meaning. To learn more about who they are in Christ through the process of formation, to belong to his family of believers and become a part of the community and to heal as they are loved and then love and help heal others through mission. Jesus Christ ushered in the Kingdom of God into our world through His death and resurrection. He invites everyone to be a part of this amazing movement by trusting and following Him. There is no fuller, richer life than the one that is lived in Christ.

In this message from his series Lessons from Philippians, Pastor Bayless reveals how your thought life determines whether peace remains or fades. You’ll discover why meditating on what is true, noble, and pure protects your heart, and you’ll learn the secret of being content whether facing need or abundance. When your trust is anchored in God, you can live independent of circumstances. Don’t miss this encouraging message that will help steady your heart.

Find out what happens when youthful ambition and innovation encounter impossible obstacles, with moments that will have you laughing, cheering, and inspired to explore the world around you.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

David is not happy having a new babysitter. David and Carter decide to behave badly. The new babysitter exhibits the Fruit of patience and kindness and they all enjoy a huge banana split together as a peace offering.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes from the coastal region of Calabria. He prepares a light brioche with gelato, a spicy sausage and ricotta pasta, and a hearty lamb au gratin with peas and asparagus.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores Lombardy's luxurious cuisine, preparing stuffed squash blossoms with parmesan, anchovies and nutmeg, followed by a rich saffron Risotto Milanese—a feast for the eyes and taste buds.

Chef Michael Bonacini explores Umbria's lush landscape and seasonal ingredients. He serves fried spicy tomato flatbread, then highlights an Umbrian speciality—black truffles with light and fluffy gnocchi.

Appreciating island culture, Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his antipasto of stuffed snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate lobster spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region.
Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of Friuli Venezia Guilia with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms.
Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini shows takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.
Chef Michael Bonacini makes Pollo Alla to showcase the bold and filling flavors of the southern region of Basilicata, Italy.
Chef Michael Bonacini cooks four of his favorite dishes, and he shares secrets of the mountainous region of Molise, Italy.

Michael Bonacini draws inspiration from the Italian region of Valle d'Aosta, which is a mountainous area near France and Switzerland, as he demonstrates how to prepare several hearty dishes, including chestnut fettuccine.
Chef Michael Bonacini explores Tuscany's fine cuisine with four dishes: Many Mushroom soup with fried sage, Lamb Ragu over pici noodles, Porchetta-Style Duck, and a smooth Creamy Coffee Custard.

Host Michael Bonacini explores the Venetian region's bounty from sea to land — serving soft shell crab with tangy sundried tomato aioli, radicchio risotto, pancetta-wrapped snapper with pea mash, and a giant almond crumb biscuit to finish.

Puglia's lush landscape and large coastline characterize its cuisine. Michael explores its native ingredients through some of his favorite Puglian meals. First up, he serves crispy fried mussels, followed by tomato and burrata risotto.
Chef Michael Bonacini explores Sicilian cuisine, where simplicity meets intensity. He kicks off with folded flatbread with ricotta and fennel seeds, followed by broccoli and sausage rigatoni.

Host Michael Bonacini explores Lazio's grand culinary traditions, showcasing its Jewish influence with crispy Roman-style fried artichokes—as crunchy as a potato chip and the perfect way to kick off a meal.
Host Michael Bonacini dives into Campania's coastal cuisine, starting with a grilled Caprese salad from Capri, then serving bold flavors with a classic spaghetti puttanesca.

Inspect prison guard Bill’s scars from a brutal attack by the spirit of a long-dead prisoner. Revisit a terrifying nursing home haunting with rookie cop Anthony, and hear the spiritual words EMT Jose used to release the soul of a troubled apparition.

Cross paths with lingering souls—a nurse believes cold spots are a stuck patient's spirit, trauma binds the dead to the living, and a ghost can't exit a hospital café.

When multiple residents report a nighttime intruder, Janet wonders if the disturbance she feels has a paranormal connection.

The remaining contestants must produce 80 portions of a lunch dish to serve from their own food truck. New series of Gordon Ramsay's American cooking competition. 18 chefs compete for the prize of a head chef position at Gordon Ramsay Steak at the Paris Las Vegas in Paradise, Nevada. In the first episode, the contestants make a dramatic arrival at Hell's Kitchen before being split into teams for the signature dish challenge. When it is time for the first evening service, the teams have very different approaches, but there are struggles on both sides which lead to firm action from Chef Ramsay.

Gordon Ramsay's American cooking competition. Evening service proves to be a disaster, but will an attempt by one team to rig the elimination succeed?

Teams cook for newly naturalized American citizens. Winners go on a safari in San Diego, while losers work the Ballona Wetlands. At dinner service, Ramsay calls in a former contestant for a pep talk. Who's eliminated?

Ramsay's teams rise early for a lamb challenge. Winners enjoy a day at the races, while losers face prep and a lunch of lamb testicles. Dinner service is a mess, with multiple chefs kicked out. Who goes home?

Teams face a Mexican challenge, cooking six dishes from 25 ingredients judged by experts. A misunderstanding sparks a blow-up, and a Mexican-themed dinner service sees multiple chefs kicked out of the kitchen.

US cooking competition with Gordon Ramsay. The remaining contestants have to create dishes for three fashion designers, who prove to be very picky about the appearance of their food. The winning team receives a shopping spree in Malibu, while the losers must put together a runway for the series' first fashion show. How will the contestants deal with the added time pressures of this special evening service?

The remaining chefs must work to please a high-profile crowd, preparing a three-course meal in sync with the fashion show happening outside; the restaurant's hectic atmosphere proves too distracting and stressful for several competitors.
US cooking competition with Gordon Ramsay. The remaining contestants have to make dishes with ingredients that are revealed to them in intervals. The winning team are rewarded with a day at a spa.
The contestants must prepare a thirty-minute meal in which a slot machine randomly determines the ingredients that they can use. The winners go on a shopping spree for kitchenware and utensils.
US cooking competition with Gordon Ramsay. It's steak night and the contestants must prepare some beef for Chef Ramsey and during a special steakhouse service.

The chefs play craps as a team and during dinner service flawless VIP service is the goal. Including special celebrity guests, Carrot Top, Lee DeWyze, and David Beckham. Can the chefs keep these VIPs happy before another chef ends up in the crapper?

Jamie Hyneman and Adam Savage find out if launching a chicken at an airplane will disrupt its flight and if a washing machine can really be deadly. They also explore the myth of the woman who swallowed an octopus egg then gave birth to an eight-legged offspring.

Special effects experts Adam Savage and Jamie Hyneman conduct experiments to try to determine if a person can become trapped in an airline toilet, if the biscuit bazooka really exists, and the truth behind the legend of the leaping lawyer.
We've all seen the Hollywood movies when a bad guy shoots a hole in a passenger jet and everyone gets sucked out the hole into the sky. Would it really happen?
Would a sinking ship pull you under? Titanic survivors said they rowed away from the vortex, and other sailors report the same—but is it true?
Can material in your toilet bowl aerate when flushed, and waft onto your toothbrush?
The MythBusters take on the Mob searching for Jimmy Hoffa, plus can a jet engine blow a car off the road and, is the daddy longlegs really the world's most venomous spider?
Larry Walters attached something like 45 weather balloons to this lawn chair. One of his tethers broke and he shot straight up into the air and apparently went up to about 16,0000 feet.

Jamie Hyneman and Adam Savage find out if a rocket attached to a '67 Chevy creates a 350-mile-per-hour road warrior and then test a stomach-exploding theory by combining fizzy candy with soda. It's sure to be a blast!

In this episode, the Mythbusters attempt to answer some of their fans' questions about previous experiments. Without fail, each new show results in a flood of viewer emails, wanting to know more, or giving suggestions about how a myth might have been tackled differently. So in the spirit of scientific investigation, Jamie and Adam return to the scene of some of their most controversial myths.
Can a scuber diver be sucked up by a fire-fighting helicopter? What really happens when you add moth balls to your gas tank? And, can a car really explode if you shoot the gas tank?
Is anything truly bulletproof? Armed with ever bigger weapons, and ever thicker targets, they set about answering that myth, once and for all.

In this episode of Mythbusters, Jamie and Adam look to answer the question lurking in the back of the mind of anyone who's ridden an elevator in a high rise building: If this suddenly falls, can I save myself by jumping up just as it's about to hit bottom?

While carrying a sheet of plywood, high up on a skyscraper construction site, a builder is caught by a gust of wind. The plywood acts like a sail and blows him off the building. However, the builder hangs on, steers the plywood like a hang-glider, and lands back in the building a few floors down. Well, that’s what the myth says.
The mythbusters love movie myths, and this episode features two film favorites.
In this episode, the Mythbusters tackle three new myths, each with the real potential to cause injury, or death. But then, Jamie and Adam wouldn’t have it any other way.

Sink your teeth into the bloodthirsty battles between stealthy Nile crocs and heavyweight hippos along Africa’s sun-scorched rivers. See why power is temporary, peace is fragile, and survival belongs to the resilient in these aquatic arenas.
Despite their considerable size, the giant offer can be remarkably difficult to find. Biologist Carolina Ribas sails through the Pantanal in search of them.
Africa is a tapestry of habitats that host an incredible variety of creatures and within the mighty continent are areas of exceptional natural beauty - the Great Parks of Africa.

This small park makes a big difference to endangered animals. Offering sanctuary to some of the biggest and smallest animals on the planet, witness how species come back from the edge of extinction to reclaim their place in Africa’s wilderness.

Considered to be the most beautiful of the Cape’s protected areas, Kogelberg Nature Reserve has experienced minimal human interference. Discover the spectacular land and sea life flourishing in this unique botanical wonderland.

Join guide Jean du Plessis for his first summit attempt on Mt. Kilimanjaro to see whether climate change has eroded its snowy peak. Learn about the pinnacle’s five climatic zones and search for clues that its volcanic heart is rumbling back to life.

Wildlife expert and safari guide Jean Du Plessis treks out to Mahale Mountains National Park, hoping to spend some time with the wild chimps living in the scrub of this remote and protected neck of the woods in Tanzania.
Watch mighty hippos and Nile crocodiles battle for survival in the place they both call home.
Evaluate the deadly weapons of poison dart frogs, piranhas, and mosquitoes.
Look at predators’ tool kits, killer bees, and bison who don’t like visitors.
Following the devastating tsunami of 2011, Japan is going through a seismic crisis. Here, get a closer look at two of the country's most dangerous volcanoes.
At the southern edge of the Pantanal, the world's largest tropical wetland on Earth, there's a place like no other, and a wildlife so diverse scientists scramble to understand it.
Located in the wild blue waters of the south-eastern Pacific, and ringed by one of the world's richest coral reefs, Cocos is a Holy Grail for divers and undersea explorers.
The Socorro Islands have been called 'The Mexican Galapagos'. Like the Galapagos, the deep blue waters of Socorro overflow with wildlife.
The islands of the Bahamas are a stunning nature-lover's paradise spread over more than 100,000 square miles of the Atlantic Ocean, about 150 miles from Florida's southeastern coast.
The disappearance of a young woman from Bend, Ore., leads to an intense manhunt after the suspect embarks on a two state crime spree.
A murder case considered closed by North Dakota detectives is suddenly reopened when a confidential informant comes forward with a tip about an unlikely suspect.
The mysterious death of a young mother in Ohio and the ensuing investigation that spans years and multiple states.
When a young woman is found dead near a soccer field in Indiana, detectives try to piece together a puzzle that leads them to an unexpected suspect.
A couple's anniversary celebration ends in murder during what appears to have been a home invasion, but investigators believe the suspect might be connected to the victim.

The murder of a young schoolteacher in Pennsylvania goes unsolved for years, but investigators discover a new tool that may finally help unlock the murderer's identity.

A look at the case of con man John Meehan, including interviews with his wife and her daughter, his ex-wife, law enforcement officers, and the Los Angeles Times reporter who shined a spotlight on the story.

A black hole causes the merging of alternative realities and leads to confusion at Stargate Command as multiple versions of the SG1 team return to the base. The event is bittersweet as the arrivals include some fallen allies whose faces they never thought they would see again. Starring Amanda Tapping and Christopher Judge.

Baal rises up against the Jaffa High Council's democratic ideology, and brainwashes some of the governing body's magnates in a bid to overthrow the regime. Mitchell finds out an old friend is dying, leaving him facing an important decision. Guest starring Cliff Simon.
Daniel is imprisoned on a world under the influence of the Ori, and the Prometheus is caught in a firefight when SG-1 tries to rescue him.
Off The Grid: SG-1 is captured on an alien world after a deal goes wrong. Plus, the planet's Stargate goes missing. Intergalactic action.

A crop of genetically engineered insects turns deadly, forcing the SG-1 team to destroy them before they and the visiting international diplomats becoming their next victims. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.
Mitchell, Carter and Daniel become out of phase while experimenting with a powerful and ancient device.
Vala returns to Stargate Command to deliver startling news. The Ori have been steadily building their arsenal, and plan a crusade against their enemies very soon...
SG-1 travels to Camelot to find a device that can help them defeat the Ori. They investigate a library guarded by a hologram called the Black Knight.
Vala, still aboard an Ori ship, watches her newly born child quickly ages and is molded to lead the Ori army.
Reports flood into the Gate Room of an extraordinary young girl leading the Ori invasion, and the SG-1 team journeys to a mysterious planet in search of the Sangraal.
Daniel and Vala travel to Atlantis in search of Merlin's anti-Ori weapon, while Sam, and Mitchell join forces with Dr. McKay.
Insiders: When Baal comes to Earth seeking help, Stargate Command must capture his clones and determine which one is the genuine article.
Uninvited: Teal'c discovers a world where people are being savagely attacked by an elusive creature, leading SG-1 to a stunning discovery about its potential origin.

While Mitchell eagerly awaits the historic 200th trip through the Stargate, the Pentagon orders the team to assist a filmmaker with his science fiction script about a wormhole in order to provide a cover for their secret program.
Counterstrike: The Jaffa take the fight to the Ori when they destroy a world that has converted to the Origin. Have their actions landed SG-1 in a war they can't control?

The fish are biting, and the market is on fire, and the question isn't whether boats will hook up, it's who will catch the biggest bluefin of them all.

Hot Tuna shares baits and advice with nearby boats hoping for a big payday. Meanwhile, Hard Merchandise gets a late afternoon hookup and races the clock to make their catch. And up north, Pinwheel takes on a fish fight that forces them to work around a pesky obstacle. Who will prevail?

You can’t keep a good captain down as Hard Merchandise’s Dave Marciano returns to bluefin fishing after his heart procedure to prove that he’s still got what it takes to stay in the game. Meanwhile, fishing in Chatham with the majority of the fleet for the first time this season, Captain Dave Carraro of FV-Tuna.com must catch a big, high-quality fish to make the trip worthwhile.

The season is entering the home stretch, and five-time champion Dave Carraro looks to put the pressure on the rest of the fleet by fishing in Chatham to extend his lead. Up north, the Pinwheel bands together while captain Tyler Mclaughlin battles through illness to get back on the water and return to the hunt for Bluefin Tuna.

The window begins to close on the North Atlantic blue fin season as fish and paychecks get bigger and bigger. However, family fishing vessel Hard Merchandise isn’t celebrating. Dave Marciano faces the devastating loss of his father and to lift the family’s spirits they plan to honor their loved one with a giant blue fin tuna.

It’s a tight race with only five-thousand dollars separating the top six boats as the quota diminishes. As the fleet digs deep to catch as many fish as possible before the season comes to an end, which determined captain will take the lead? Can 8th place underdogs Wicked Pissah stage a comeback? And which boat will go the distance for that last crucial paycheck?
Rumors swirl around the fleet that the quota is almost gone, and that there may only be a few more days left to fish.
With nearly every boat in contention on the season's last day, each captain hopes to make the move that will earn them the title of the GOAT.

After a long winter, it’s bluefin season again in Gloucester, Massachusetts. The fleet is eager for a paycheck and it’s not long before they’re on the meat with jumbo tunas. With more catches than ever in Wicked Tuna history, the captains must decide whether to test their luck in Chatham or fish locally.

In the fishiest season Gloucester has seen in years, the fleet battles it out to try and land Bluefin bigger and better than their competition. TJ and Tyler make the run to Maine, betting on the cooler water being the key to landing a jumbo. Meanwhile, the rest of the fleet fishes local, hoping that staying in their comfort zone is the right strategy.

Stress levels rise on Hard Merchandise as they struggle to catch their first fish. Marciano hates crowds, but that’s where the fish are. Son Joe and nephew Jay propose a new strategy, but will Dave be too stubborn to listen? In this fierce competition, one monster bluefin can change the game, and tensions ramp up as captains grow territorial over their best fishing spots.

Captain Michelle Bancewicz of the No Limits takes a huge risk traveling ninety miles in the hopes of finally catching their first blue fin tuna of the season. Proving they’ll do whatever it takes to get a paycheck, the No Limits finally lands a 105-inch blue fin. Closer to Gloucester, F/V Tuna Dot Com strikes blue gold on crowded fishing grounds with the heaviest fish of the season so far.

The season is off to a fishy start, but two captains struggle to gain ground. Captain Jack Patrician of the Time Flies has been on a tough losing streak as he and mate, Anders Strickland, grapple to find their groove as a new team. Meanwhile Captain Michelle Bancewicz needs to trust her gut instead of following the crowd.

Halfway through the season, the DotCom, Wicked Pissah alliance continues to be a force to be reckoned when Paul saves Dave from disaster on the water and reaps the good karma that comes with it. Meanwhile, the rest of the fleet pulls out all the stops in hopes of making up ground in the standings before it’s too late.

With captains Dave on Dot.com and Paul on Wicked Pissah working together and leading the fleet, middle-of-the-pack Captain Jack and new mate Anders on Time Flies go it alone, gunning for the front runners as they battle monster bluefin. Meanwhile, Tyler on Pinwheel and Marciano on Hard Merchandise form their own alliance seeking to gain an advantage.
